affinity.description: Affinity rules for scheduling the DaemonSet pods

cpuDeviceMode.description: **Deprecated:** folded into the generated `driverConfig` ConfigMap and takes priority over it; use `driverConfig.cpuDeviceMode` instead. CPU exposure mode: `grouped` (expose NUMA nodes or sockets as devices) or `individual` (expose each CPU as a device); defaults to `grouped` when empty.

exposePCIeRoots.description: Discover and expose PCIe roots as device attributes. Requires the `DRAListTypeAttributes=true` feature gate in the cluster. Not configurable via `driverConfig`; use this flag instead

groupBy.description: **Deprecated:** folded into the generated `driverConfig` ConfigMap and takes priority over it; use `driverConfig.groupBy` instead. Grouping criteria when `cpuDeviceMode=grouped`: `numanode`, `socket` or `machine`; defaults to `numanode` when empty.

hostnameOverride.description: **Deprecated:** folded into the generated `driverConfig` ConfigMap and takes priority over it; use `driverConfig.hostnameOverride` instead. Overrides the node name the driver registers under.

reservedCPUs.description: **Deprecated:** folded into the generated `driverConfig` ConfigMap and takes priority over it; use `driverConfig.reservedCPUs` instead. CPUs reserved for the OS and kubelet, excluded from DRA management (e.g. `"0-1"`).

driverConfig.description: Driver config file contents. When non-empty, or when a deprecated `args.*` field below is set, a ConfigMap is created and mounted into the driver container as /etc/dracpu/config.yaml. `args.*` fields that mirror a deprecated CLI flag (`cpuDeviceMode`, `groupBy`, `reservedCPUs`, `hostnameOverride`) are folded into the generated config automatically and take priority over the same field set here.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the driver container

extraVolumes.description: Extra volumes for the DaemonSet pod

global.description: Global values shared between all subcharts
global.$comment: Added automatically by 'helm schema' to allow this chart to be used as a Helm dependency, as the `additionalProperties` setting would otherwise collide with Helm's special 'global' values key.

healthzPath.description: Path for liveness and readiness probes

healthzPort.description: Port the HTTP server binds to; used for the container port and probes

tag.description: Image tag; defaults to `.Chart.AppVersion` when empty, which is set to the release tag at package time

kubeletRootDir.description: Kubelet base directory (the kubelet's own `--root-dir`). Only set this if the kubelet does not use the default. The hostPath mounts and the driver flag both derive from this value, so they cannot come apart. Once cleaned it may not contain `$(` or `$$`, which the kubelet can reinterpret in a container's argument but never in `hostPath.path` or `volumeMount.mountPath`. See https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/dra-driver-cpu/blob/main/docs/user/configuration.md for details

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for scheduling the DaemonSet pods

podLabels.description: Extra labels to add to pods

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the ServiceAccount

tolerations.description: Node tolerations; defaults to tolerating all NoSchedule taints

driverconfig.schema.json.$comment: Schema for driverConfig values. Mirrors internal/driverconfig/config.go Config struct, except bindAddress, exposePCIeRoots, and kubeletRootDir, which are rejected in the config file — use healthzPort, args.exposePCIeRoots, and either the chart's top-level kubeletRootDir value or --kubelet-root-dir for direct binary use. Generated by 'make driverconfig-schema'; do not edit by hand.
